act-emergency-event-form.title: Decide where emergency cleaning of pumps is recorded (SDWS 3)

evidence.text:
decided by Adriaan Mol, 10 Oct 2026. SDWS 3 emergency events are recorded on the sampling form itself, so the event, the cleaning and the retest sit in one record.

Hand pumps, "Clean Water || Water Quality Sampling_sdws3" (43c96af4bc4240c0b5c4402383b9c539, now rev 192):
- WS7.9 "Why is this sample being taken?" (required): routine monitoring round / commissioning of a new or rehabilitated pump / after a contamination event / retest after a failed result.
- Only when the answer is "after a contamination event": WS7.10 event type (flood, cyclone or storm, latrine overflow or runoff, other), WS7.11 event date (Don't Know allowed), WS7.12 cleaning (shock chlorination) date, WS7.13 who cleaned it.

Piped systems, "Piped Water || Water Quality Sampling_sdws3" (ef8cf7353a974cf984d34860dcf2952d, now rev 82): the same block as 1.11 to 1.15, worded for systems (pipe burst instead of latrine runoff; cleaned and chlorinated).

The result itself goes on the results form as now, linked through the sampling record. Cathy Emmanuella carries out the retests and fills in the block on site.

evidence.text:
annual independent cross-check of people per premises (SDWS 25), 7 Oct 2026.

Source: INSTAT RGPH-3, census of June 2018 — the most recent official household size by region.
• Anosy 4.3 (Tome 1, Tableau 26, p.41); Taolagnaro district 4.3 (Tome 2, Tableau 14, p.160); urban commune of Fort Dauphin 4.0 (Tome 2, Tableau 16, p.213).
• Analanjirofo 3.6 (Tome 1, Tableau 26, p.41); Maroantsetra district 3.6 (Tome 2, Tableau 14, p.159); urban commune of Maroantsetra 3.3 (Tome 2, Tableau 16, p.195).

Checked first, in order: INSTAT TBSE Dec 2025 — the Analanjirofo edition (Tableau 4, PDF p.20) only reprints the 2018 census sizes (it prints 3,5 for the region; the census counts themselves round to 3.6); no Anosy edition exists. EDS-V 2021 (household composition table) gives national 4.3, urban 4.0, rural 4.4 only.

Comparison with the project survey, Nov 2025 (people per premises):
• Fort-Dauphin 4.47: +0.17 (+4%) above Anosy and Taolagnaro; +0.47 (+12%) above Fort Dauphin town.
• Maroantsetra 3.66: +0.06 (+2%) above Analanjirofo and the district; +0.36 (+11%) above Maroantsetra town.
Census figures not scaled for growth (growth changes the number of households, not their size). The census counts ordinary households; the survey counts premises, which can hold more than one household.

Files: Central Data Hub - Water Documents/Evidence/SDWS25 household size/ (RGPH-3 Tome 1 and Tome 2, RGPH-3 household characteristics report, TBSE Analanjirofo Dec 2025, EDS-V 2021 FR376). On the report: SDWS 25 section, #sdws25-crosscheck.
